entries.title: No sign of larger hantavirus outbreak, says UN health agency
entries.snippet: The situation could still change and there might be more confirmed cases, warns the head of the World Health Organization.

entries.title: Trump says Iran ceasefire is on 'massive life support'
entries.snippet: The US president criticises an Iranian counteroffer to end the war, and says the month-long ceasefire is "unbelievably weak".

entries.title: Lebanon says two paramedics among 13 killed in Israeli strikes
entries.snippet: Lebanon's health ministry says the paramedics were carrying out a rescue mission in Nabatieh in response to an earlier attack that killed one person.

entries.title: Zelensky's ex-chief of staff in court as Ukraine corruption probe escalates
entries.snippet: Andriy Yermak was named by Ukraine's two anti-corruption agencies as a suspect in a money-laundering scheme.

entries.title: US inflation jumps to 3.8% as energy costs surge from Iran war
entries.snippet: The key measure of US inflation rises its highest level since May 2023 as consumers feel the impact of the Iran war.

entries.title: Hamas 'weaponised' sexual violence in 7 October attacks, Israeli investigation says
entries.snippet: The most comprehensive report of its kind details harrowing cases of sexual attacks which it says were systematic.

entries.title: Dali ship operator charged over deadly Baltimore bridge collapse
entries.snippet: Six construction workers were killed and several vehicles plunged into the river after the cargo ship crashed into the bridge.

entries.title: eBay rejects $55.5bn offer from GameStop
entries.snippet: The online auction giant said it doubted how the video game retailer would finance its offer.

entries.title: Uganda's president sworn in for record seventh term
entries.snippet: Yoweri Museveni, 81, won disputed elections in January to extend his 40-year rule.

entries.title: South Africa's top court bars repeat asylum applications
entries.snippet: The home affairs minister hails the ruling as a "victory" against the "abuse" of the refugee system.

entries.title: EU needs to delay social media access for children - von der Leyen
entries.snippet: She told an EU summit that an expert panel was due to come up with steps on how to protect minors online by July.

entries.title: Mexico cancels plans to end school year early for World Cup
entries.snippet: Parents were angry at a proposal to end classes on 5 June instead of 15 July due to the tournament and expected extreme heat.

entries.title: Snack giant switches to black and white packaging as Iran war hits ink supplies
entries.snippet: The effective closure of the Strait of Hormuz has severely disrupted global supplies of energy and petrochemicals.

entries.title: Canvas hack: Company pays criminals to delete students' stolen data
entries.snippet: The company behind Canvas says it has "reached an agreement" with the hackers who disrupted thousands of colleges and universities.

entries.title: Texas accuses Netflix of spying on users, including children
entries.snippet: The lawsuit comes amid increased scrutiny over platform features like auto-play that deliver endless content to users.

entries.title: France seeks to move beyond colonial ties by meeting African leaders in Kenya
entries.snippet: In a first since these meetings started in the 1970s, this move reflects a change in France's thinking.

entries.title: Pakistan struck a rehab centre and killed 269 Afghans. Their families want to know why
entries.snippet: There are calls to investigate the 16 March airstrike - which the UN says likely killed more - as a war crime.

entries.title: How the Trump-Xi summit could set superpower relations for many years to come
entries.snippet: Trump's whirlwind visit to China is the most significant for years - but will it bear fruit?

entries.title: Ex-Philippine leader Duterte's drug war enforcer escapes ICC arrest
entries.snippet: Senator Ronald "Bato" Dela Rosa, a former national police chief, has sought refuge in the senate.

entries.title: 'Britain at the heart of Europe': How Starmer's plans are going down in the EU
entries.snippet: Sir Keir Starmer pledged to rebuild the UK's relationship with Europe in a defiant speech on Monday.

entries.title: Jason Collins, NBA's first openly gay player, dies at 47 of brain tumor
entries.snippet: Jason Collins, the NBA's first openly gay player who went on to become a pioneer for inclusion and an ambassador for the league, has died after an eight-month battle with an aggressive form of a brain tumor, his family announced Tuesday.

entries.title: OpenAI's Sam Altman takes the stand to fend off Elon Musk's accusations he 'stole a charity'
entries.snippet: The trial pits two of tech's most famous personalities against each other and could lead to seismic changes for the maker of ChatGPT.

entries.title: Omaha's U.S. House race will test candidates' ability to reach beyond party lines
entries.snippet: Omaha, Neb., is home to a toss-up Congressional race this year. Voters have shown a willingness to vote for moderate candidates from both parties, but has the definition of a moderate now changed?

entries.title: About 7 million kids live in a home with a loaded and unlocked gun, a study finds
entries.snippet: The new study in JAMA Network Open also finds that more parents leave their guns loaded and unlocked when they have teenagers, despite the fact that suicide risk goes up for this age group.

entries.title: How Americans see China now
entries.snippet: As President Trump heads to China this week, a new NPR-Chicago Council-Ipsos poll finds most Americans think U.S. tariffs have hurt both economies, and that the Iran war is bad for America.

entries.title: The SPLC survived firebombs and death threats. Will it survive Trump 2.0?
entries.snippet: The Southern Poverty Law Center is facing a serious threat from the Justice Department — and comes at a time when several former and current SPLC employees say the group is already deeply vulnerable.

entries.title: FDA commissioner resigns after tumultuous tenure
entries.snippet: The resignation ends Dr. Marty Makary's management of the Food and Drug Administration, which was marked by turmoil and controversy.

entries.title: Alabama splits U.S. House primaries after court ruling; S.C. redistricting stalls
entries.snippet: Alabama will hold a special primary election for four of its seven congressional districts, after the Supreme Court cleared the way — and as redistricting ripples through the South.

entries.title: Israel's government is expected to collapse over ultra-Orthodox military draft
entries.snippet: An ultra-Orthodox Jewish party in Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's coalition has called for parliament to be dissolved, threatening to bring down the government.

entries.title: Transportation Secretary Duffy filmed a reality show, funded by firms he regulates
entries.snippet: Secretary Duffy, his wife and nine kids took a "Great American Road Trip" to celebrate America's 250th. They say no taxpayers funded the project. But a nonprofit with transport-related sponsors did.

entries.title: Hegseth grilled over direction of Iran war and costs for Americans
entries.snippet: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth testified in back-to-back Capitol Hill hearings where he faced bipartisan frustration about the Iran war and its rising costs. With neither the Americans nor the Iranians softening their demands, the President left for a high-stakes visit to Iran's

entries.title: Inflation could hit 4% next month and stay elevated for rest of year, economist warns
entries.snippet: The latest inflation report shows price increases for American consumers in April hit a three-year high, driven by a spike in the cost of gasoline. The Consumer Price Index, which includes energy and food costs, rose 3.8% year-over-year, according to the Labor Department. Geoff B

entries.title: What's at stake as Trump heads to China for talks with Xi
entries.snippet: President Trump is traveling halfway around the world for a state visit to China, and he's bringing a host of top American executives with him. Talks there are expected to encompass the complex economic and security postures of both nations. Nick Schifrin reports from Beijing.

entries.title: News Wrap: FDA head Marty Makary resigning after uneven tenure
entries.snippet: In our news wrap Tuesday, FDA head Marty Makary is resigning after an uneven tenure at the agency, UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer is refusing to resign despite growing pressure from within his own party, and FBI Director Kash Patel pushed back against accusations that he drinks t

entries.title: Louisiana's redistricting rush ignites debate over race and representation
entries.snippet: With its House primary contests off the calendar for now, Louisiana is taking another step to redraw its political battle lines. The move comes after the Supreme Court once again pared back landmark civil rights protections. Once the lines are settled in Louisiana, the impacts wi

entries.title: Israeli lawmakers set up a special tribunal and allow for death penalty for Hamas-led 2023 attackers
entries.snippet: Rights groups have criticized the measure, saying it makes the death penalty too easy to impose while also doing away with procedures safeguarding the right to a fair trial.

entries.title: Inside Izyum, the Ukrainian frontline city facing the threat of a 2nd Russian occupation
entries.snippet: As Russia prepares for a large-scale spring offensive, a city near the frontline is preparing for the worst. Control of Izyum is vital for Ukraine as the link between Kharkiv and Donetsk. Izyum was occupied by Russian forces for six months in 2022. Ukrainian forces liberated it a

entries.title: Students question value of college as costs rise and AI reshapes jobs
entries.snippet: This season's college commencement celebrations come at a sobering moment. Students are facing steep loans and dicey job prospects, especially in the AI era. That's led many to question whether a college degree is worth it anymore. Paul Solman visited Michigan to find out how som

entries.title: Helen Zoe Veit and Amna Nawaz discuss picky eaters on 'Settle In'
entries.snippet: How did American kids become such picky eaters? On our Settle In podcast, Amna Nawaz asked that question to author and historian Helen Zoe Veit. Her latest book is "Picky: How American Children Became the Fussiest Eaters in History."

entries.title: Conan O'Brien will return to host the 99th Academy Awards next year
entries.snippet: Despite a dip in viewership this year, social media engagement rose significantly.

entries.title: U.K. Prime Minister Starmer defiant as calls for his resignation grow
entries.snippet: While more than 100 Labour lawmakers signed a letter of support for Starmer, about 90 others urged him to set a timetable for his departure.

entries.title: WATCH: 'I don't think about Americans' financial situation' when negotiating with Iran, Trump says
entries.snippet: A reporter asked Trump on Tuesday to what extent Americans' financial straits are motivating him to make a deal.

entries.title: Trump's redistricting push falters in South Carolina Senate but notches a win in Missouri's top court
entries.snippet: South Carolina senators defied his push Tuesday, while Missouri's top court upheld a new map backed by Trump that could benefit Republicans in the midterm elections.

entries.title: WATCH: Murray calls Pentagon's Iran war cost estimate 'suspiciously low,' presses for damage price tag
entries.snippet: Jules Hurst, the Pentagon comptroller, told members of Congress at an earlier hearing before a House Appropriations panel, that the cost of the war had risen to $29 billion.

entries.title: Push for South Carolina to join congressional redistricting battle fails as Republicans reject map
entries.snippet: The 29-17 vote failed, with just two votes short of the two-thirds needed.

entries.title: WATCH: FBI Director Kash Patel, ATF, DEA heads testify in Senate hearing
entries.snippet: FBI Director Kash Patel angrily lashed out at a Democratic lawmaker at a budget hearing Tuesday, calling allegations that he drinks excessively on the job and has been unreachable at times to his staff "unequivocally, categorically false."

entries.title: Appeals court says Trump doesn't have to pay $83 million to E. Jean Carroll — for now
entries.snippet: The 2nd U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals has agreed to let Trump delay the payment to E. Jean Carroll as long as he posts a $7.4 million bond to cover interest that would accrue through October.

entries.title: Supreme Court halts order on Alabama's U.S. House map, giving GOP an opening to gain seat
entries.snippet: The U.S. Supreme Court on Monday set the stage for Alabama to eliminate one of two largely Black congressional districts before this year's midterm elections.

entries.title: Ship operators fear fuel shortages as Iran war squeezes supply
entries.snippet: Experts say consumers and companies should brace for price spikes to shipping costs and impacts to bottom lines.

entries.title: Memphis Grizzlies forward Brandon Clarke dies at 29
entries.snippet: Memphis Grizzlies forward Brandon Clarke has died, according to the team, his agency and the NBA.

entries.title: DW
entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: Canvas owner secures student data in deal with hacking group
entries.snippet: The ShinyHunters hacking group stole student data from the popular education platform Canvas last week. Parent company Instructure apologized for the hack and said Canvas "remains safe to use."

entries.title: Iran: Surge of political prisoners amid US-Israel war
entries.snippet: Amid the US-Israel war with Iran, as the world breathlessly watches the Strait of Hormuz, Tehran is quietly increasing pressure on political prisoners. Advocates are sounding the alarm, warning of mass executions.

entries.title: EU invites Taliban members to discuss Afghan migrant returns
entries.snippet: The European Commission has invited officials from Afghanitan's Taliban to discuss the returns of certain migrants. It's controversial on humanitarian grounds, and because Brussels doesn't recognize Taliban authority.

entries.title: War in Iran: Despite Iranian attacks, Doha steps up mediation efforts
entries.snippet: Qatar is intensifying regional mediation efforts despite the Iran war bringing airstrikes and cutting off Doha's access to global oil markets. But can Qatar leverage its ties to the US and Iran for its own benefit?

entries.title: As super 'El Nino' looms, wildfires are set to heat up
entries.snippet: More than 150 million hectares — over twice the size of Texas — burned globally in the first months of 2026. With a high chance of a supercharged El Nino, the second half of the year could be even worse.

entries.title: Nigeria airstrike kills 100 at market, Amnesty says
entries.snippet: Amnesty International is calling for an investigation, saying the strike was the latest deadly attack to kill civilians. The military denies that civilians were harmed.

entries.title: 2026 Rainbow Map delivers mixed picture on LGBTQ+ rights
entries.snippet: ILGA Europe has released its annual ranking of LGBTQ+ rights across Europe and Central Asia, with Spain taking the top spot for the first time. But behind the numbers, activists warn of a growing backlash against LGBTQ+.

entries.title: Bundesliga: Kathleen Krüger appointed Hamburg's head of sport
entries.snippet: Hamburg have appointed Kathleen Krüger as the club's new board member responsible for sport. She becomes the first woman to fill such a role at a Bundesliga club on a permanent basis.

entries.title: Trump-Xi summit: High stakes for the US, China and the world
entries.snippet: US President Donald Trump is hoping for a foreign policy win at the upcoming summit with China's Xi Jinping. The Iran war, trade deals and Taiwan are expected to be high on the agenda during Trump's visit to Beijing.

entries.title: Thailand scraps Cambodia naval pact amid sinking ties
entries.snippet: Bangkok's decision to end MoU 44, a long-stalled maritime agreement with Cambodia, is a win for Thai nationalists. This comes as Cambodia struggles to garner international support amid controversy over scam centers.

entries.title: Sport helping displaced Lebanese living in stadium to cope
entries.snippet: More than a million people have been forced to flee their homes in southern Lebanon due to fighting between Israeli forces and Hezbollah. As many shelter in Beirut stadiums, sport is sometimes a welcome distraction.

entries.title: 'Work not over,' says WHO after hantavirus evacuation
entries.snippet: Extensive testing, contact tracing, and quarantine procedures are still needed to contain the outbreak, WHO says. However, it has stressed that the current outbreak is vastly different to the COVID-19 pandemic.

entries.title: Germany news: Merz booed as he advocates economic reform
entries.snippet: Chancellor Friedrich Merz says Germany must buckle down to ensure economic renewal, amid geopolitical turmoil. Meanwhile, inflation is up again with energy prices a key driver pushing up costs. DW has the latest.

entries.title: UK: Keir Starmer tells Cabinet he will continue in place, as four junior ministers quit
entries.snippet: British Prime Minister Keir Starmer has met with his Cabinet amid continued pressure after election losses. A set piece speech yesterday failed to calm the waters, and four junior ministers resigned on Tuesday.

entries.title: Young hijab-wearing German beauty contestant takes on the AfD
entries.snippet: As a Miss Germany contestant, Büsra Sayed wore a hijab on stage. This had never happened before — and the AfD didn't like it. Her response went viral.

entries.title: India: New Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Vijay cracks down on state-run TASMAC liquor shops
entries.snippet: In his first major decision since becoming the chief minister of Tamil Nadu, Vijay has ordered 717 state-run TASMAC liquor stores near religious places and schools to shut down.

entries.title: What now for the role of high representative in Bosnia?
entries.snippet: Christian Schmidt's departure as high representative in Bosnia and Herzegovina doesn't look like a routine diplomatic handover. It seems to indicate that international powers want something different from the role.

entries.title: Ukraine: Russia breaks ceasefire overnight, Zelenskyy says
entries.snippet: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy has said that Moscow launched some 200 drone strikes in a single night, bringing an end to a temporary truce. Moscow meanwhile said it intercepted 27 Ukrainian drones overnight.

entries.title: EU negotiators agree new rules on vital medicines
entries.snippet: A new agreement aims to tackle the drug shortages that have plagued the bloc. Among other things, it would make it easier to use public funds to support the production of essential medicines.
